verdict.rationale: Wise documents sending payments globally in 40+ currencies, holding and converting balances in up to 56 currencies to fund transfers, and locking the exact amount the recipient will get for up to 24 hours. It also claims no hidden fees or markups, which addresses fee transparency. Missing for 10: detailed first-party documentation of the fee structure and how fees are disclosed per transfer, and independent or hands-on corroboration of fee transparency on business payments.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can send international payments in local currencies with transparent fees

citations.quote: Make payments and get paid in 40+ currencies.
